description.en: Your own picture behind the whole page, dimmed a little, with a frosted glass card on top. It comes with a dusk mountain scene; give it any image address to use yours. Organization admins can install it.
Address of the picture behind the page, 1920 pixels wide or more. You can upload one under Resources in Casdoor and paste its address here.
The button and checkboxes. Pick a color from your picture.
